Shadowing Practice: Introducing Yourself

Hello, my name is Aman.
I'm an English teacher from India.
I love helping people speak with confidence.
In my free time, I enjoy reading and walking.
It's lovely to meet you.

How to practise: listen to each line, then repeat it aloud in the same speed and tone. 5 minutes daily makes a big difference.
